_comment: Prospective ledger for the short-dated fade cycle (2026-07-02 audit repointing). Records EVERY gated evaluation in the validated <=14d 0.90-0.98 bucket: entries AND skips. Purpose = the edge's falsification test (N~30-50): (a) if entered fades' realized excess <=0, the bucket edge is gone; (b) if SKIPS systematically resolve NO (fade would have won), the robust-edge haircut is over-broad and forfeiting +EV. Update outcomes at resolution. Fields: date, question, side, ask, days, pop_edge_pp (scanner population avg), catalyst_p_central (instance P(side) from gate), decision, reason, size_usd, outcome (null until resolved), fade_would_have_won (for skips).

records.question: Will Iga Świątek be the 2026 Women's Wimbledon Winner?
records.reason: Edge INVERTED on instance analysis: structured breakdown P(win)=14.7% (defending champion, dominant R3 form) vs market 9.8% — the market may UNDERPRICE her. Central p_NO 0.86 < ask 0.902 = negative edge before haircut.

records.question: Will Alexander Zverev be the 2026 Men's Wimbledon winner?
records.reason: Positive at central (p_NO 0.95 vs 0.905 = +$0.30 on $6) but fails the pessimistic bound (0.90 -> -$0.03 vs +$0.05 required). Did NOT override the default haircut on ledger candidate #1 — unforced data first; if skips like this systematically resolve NO, the ledger recalibrates the haircut at N~30-50, not N=1.
